be that it tasted amazing with creamy to it next we had crispy chapa which is basically crispy crump coated fried fish with curry leaves seasoning which gave it unique flavour this was an outstanding cheese and was true to its name but the down side of the pizza was its base the pizza base was really hard and dry which overall brings down the dish but still had it because of the amazing topping we had platter of fish fingers and fries and it was excellent both the fish fingers and the fries were good after devouring all these starters we could only go for two main course dishes and so we decided to go for the special 7h biriyani and spaghetti aglio olio am in love with their biriyani it was not_like any other biriyani that have ever tasted before it was unique and it was excellent too favourites now coming to the desserts we had vanilla ice cream and gulab jamuns would say the makan tutup section does not_provide for much choices the jamuna were decent we also had some moctails in between which were not_up to the mark they need to improve their moctails the only one felt was perfect was the virgin mojito other mocktails we had were not_good we had some litchi based ones and orange based ones and also pinacolada flavoured one but we did not_like these much overall would say that the offers really makan and the suasana is also great the drinks need immense improvement
